docker-mailbox v1.0.0

- Initial release providing a unified REST API and MCP server for controlling multiple IMAP/SMTP mailboxes on a single port.
- Supports reading, searching, sending, marking as seen, and deleting mail across multiple inboxes in one call.
- Unified `GET /inbox` endpoint fans out searches across all configured mailboxes and merges results newest-first.
- Optional bearer-token authentication; `/health` endpoint is always open for liveness checks.
- No state, message store, or per-provider client library required—uses Python stdlib and FastAPI.
- Supports granular mailbox operations, full structured search, and simple per-mailbox requests.
